title: The Odyssey
synopsis: Ten years home from Troy. You are Odysseus. The sea has, against all reason, opinions. Penelope weaves and unweaves and waits.

nodes.text: The horse, the gates, the smoke.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Spare a survivor” back. Mercy shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Soldier.

nodes.text: A drug that erases home.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Captain—follows you into whatever comes next.
You commit to “Stay yourself.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Polyphemus. Sheep. A cave.

choices.text: Tell him your name is Nobody
choices.consequence: There is no taking “Tell him your name is Nobody” back. Cunning shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You commit to “Boast your name.” The story records the instinct as “Pride” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: He gives you the bag of winds.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Wise—follows you into whatever comes next.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Foolish—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Winds escape. You are blown back.

choices.consequence: “Forgive them” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honor.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Anger—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Giants throw rocks. Ships are crushed.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Cut and run” back. Save shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Foolish.

nodes.text: Pigs. A drink. A goddess.

choices.consequence: “Take Hermes' moly” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.
“Drink unprotected” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Foolish.

nodes.text: Comfort. The crew softens.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Discipline—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Tiresias' prophecy. Your mother as a shade.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Discipline.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Heart.

nodes.text: Wax in their ears. Ropes on your mast.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Bind tight” back. Wise shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
There is no taking “Loose enough to listen” back. Curious shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Choose six lives or all.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Cold math.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Foolish.

nodes.text: Don't eat them. The crew, hungry, does.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Stop them.” The story records the instinct as “Discipline” and carries it forward.
“Let them” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Tired.

nodes.text: Zeus' bolt. You alone live.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Cling to the keel.” The story records the instinct as “Survive” and carries it forward.
“Swim” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: Seven years on her island.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Refuse her gift” back. Honor shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
There is no taking “Stay” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Their ship returns you to Ithaca, asleep.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honor.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Tired.

nodes.text: Athena disguises you.

choices.consequence: “Walk to the swineherd” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Foolish.

nodes.text: Your son meets you. You weep.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honor.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Wise.

nodes.text: Penelope's bow. Suitors fail.

choices.consequence: You commit to “String it slowly.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.
“String it fast” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Pride.

nodes.text: Arrows through the hall.

choices.consequence: “Spare the bard” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Mercy.
“Spare none” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Soldier.

nodes.text: Penelope tests you with a bed only you can know.

choices.text: Tell her the truth of the bed
choices.consequence: You commit to “Tell her the truth of the bed.” The story records the instinct as “Honor” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Pride—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Your father in the orchard.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Heart.
There is no taking “Wait for proof” back. Wise shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You rule Ithaca again. Penelope at your side. Telemachus learns. You die old, in bed, with the sea in the distance.
Tiresias' prophecy comes due. You take an oar inland until a stranger calls it a winnowing fan. You die a peaceful death far from the water.
Demodocus and others sing your story. You become, eventually, a poem instead of a man. The poem outlives every kingdom you fought in or for.
